slides.idea: Who says a topic is agreed?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "Who says a topic is agreed?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A "Only JL": one person holding a big rubber stamp
 Card B "The person it is for", circled in orange with a small tag "leaning": a person holding a card with a name line on it
 Card C "Anyone, recorded": three people beside an open notebook
Bottom-right sticky note with a big question mark: "Still open: an Owner line on the face?"
Focal point: card B.
slides.notes: Leaning: the second (proposal 261029): the face names that person, the pass records the word. Still open: Does a topic need an Owner line on its face?

slides.idea: What does a closed topic leave behind?
slides.content:
Headline (top-left, large): "What does a closed topic leave behind?"
Three option cards across the middle, joined by a wavy line:
 Card A "Kept, folded", circled in orange with a small tag "leaning": a folder folded shut with a grey ribbon
 Card B "Moved to _closed/": a folder sliding into a box labelled "_closed"
 Card C "Deleted": a folder in a bin, two small arrows out of it to labels "Report" and "delivery/"
Bottom-right sticky note: "Links from other topics still land"
Focal point: card A.
slides.notes: Leaning: kept, folded (proposal 261029): Links from other topics still land, its Decided lines stay citable. Still open: Is a closed topic ever deleted?
